Mid-length, bouncy electric yellow hair with a small side ponytail and soft curls. Large, sparkling bright blue eyes with a cheerful expression. Appears as a youthful teenager with rounded cheeks. Petite and slight build. A white and light blue sailor-style dress with a short skirt and a blue ribbon. A small, compact light grey mechanical rigging unit with a single small cannon.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
